frame_row: Structural top of the bridge. It instantiates the input slices, the two request engines, the arbiter, the response decoder, the two slot tables, and the storage, and holds no logic of its own. The AXI4 interface is on the left and top, the TL-UL interface on top and bottom.

label: u_ar_skid
(m_vlsit_axi2tlul_skid)
blocks.function: Two-entry slice of the read address channel with registered ready; an empty slice passes a beat in the same cycle.

label: u_aw_skid
(m_vlsit_axi2tlul_skid)
blocks.function: Two-entry slice of the write address channel with registered ready; an empty slice passes a beat in the same cycle.

label: u_w_skid
(m_vlsit_axi2tlul_skid)
blocks.function: Two-entry slice of the write data channel with registered ready; holds data that arrives before its address.

label: u_rd_req
(m_vlsit_axi2tlul_rd_req)
blocks.function: Checks the read burst, generates the beat address, size, and lane mask of each beat, and presents one read request per cycle; for an illegal burst it creates error beats without a request.

label: u_wr_req
(m_vlsit_axi2tlul_wr_req)
blocks.function: Checks the write burst, pairs each data beat with its beat address, derives the strobe mask and the write opcode, presents one write request per cycle, and drops the data of an illegal burst.

label: u_arb
(m_vlsit_axi2tlul_arb)
blocks.function: Selects the read or the write request by the arbitration mode, builds the tag and the user bits, and loads the request output register that holds the request until the device accepts it.

label: u_rsp_dec
(m_vlsit_axi2tlul_rsp_dec)
blocks.function: Accepts every response beat, decodes the direction and slot from the tag, checks the slot and the opcode, and reports orphaned and wrong-opcode responses.

label: u_rd_rob
(m_vlsit_axi2tlul_rd_rob)
blocks.function: Read slot table with ID contexts: reserves a slot per request, keeps the slots of one ID in request order, chooses the burst to return, passes the data straight to the read output register when possible, keeps other data in the storage, and never interleaves bursts.

label: u_wr_rob
(m_vlsit_axi2tlul_wr_rob)
blocks.function: Write slot table with ID contexts: reserves a slot per request, keeps the slots of one ID in request order, accumulates the error of a burst, and loads the write response register at the last beat of a burst.

label: u_evt
(m_vlsit_axi2tlul_evt)
blocks.function: Registers the three status pulses: the orphaned and wrong-opcode conditions of the response decoder and the illegal-burst conditions of the two request engines, one cycle later.

label: u_rd_store
(m_vlsit_axi2tlul_store)
blocks.function: Read data storage with one write port and one read port and a read latency of one cycle; an array or an SRAM macro.

interfaces.name: AXI read address channel
interfaces.signals: external -> TOP: i_axi_arvalid, i_axi_arid, i_axi_araddr, i_axi_arlen, i_axi_arsize, i_axi_arburst, i_axi_arlock, i_axi_arcache, i_axi_arprot, i_axi_arqos, i_axi_arregion; TOP -> external: o_axi_arready

interfaces.name: AXI write address channel
interfaces.signals: external -> TOP: i_axi_awvalid, i_axi_awid, i_axi_awaddr, i_axi_awlen, i_axi_awsize, i_axi_awburst, i_axi_awlock, i_axi_awcache, i_axi_awprot, i_axi_awqos, i_axi_awregion; TOP -> external: o_axi_awready

interfaces.name: AXI write data channel
interfaces.signals: external -> TOP: i_axi_wvalid, i_axi_wdata, i_axi_wstrb, i_axi_wlast; TOP -> external: o_axi_wready

interfaces.name: AXI read data channel
interfaces.signals: TOP -> external: o_axi_rvalid, o_axi_rid, o_axi_rdata, o_axi_rresp, o_axi_rlast; external -> TOP: i_axi_rready

interfaces.name: AXI write response channel
interfaces.signals: TOP -> external: o_axi_bvalid, o_axi_bid, o_axi_bresp; external -> TOP: i_axi_bready

interfaces.name: TL-UL request channel A
interfaces.signals: TOP -> external: o_tl_a_valid, o_tl_a_opcode, o_tl_a_param, o_tl_a_size, o_tl_a_src, o_tl_a_addr, o_tl_a_mask, o_tl_a_data, o_tl_a_user; external -> TOP: i_tl_a_ready

interfaces.name: TL-UL response channel D
interfaces.signals: external -> TOP: i_tl_d_valid, i_tl_d_opcode, i_tl_d_param, i_tl_d_size, i_tl_d_src, i_tl_d_sink, i_tl_d_data, i_tl_d_user, i_tl_d_err; TOP -> external: o_tl_d_ready

interfaces.name: Status pulses
interfaces.signals: TOP -> external: o_evt_orphan_resp, o_evt_bad_resp, o_evt_axi_err_rd, o_evt_axi_err_wr

interfaces.name: Clock and reset
interfaces.signals: i_clk_main, i_rst_n_main

interfaces.name: Read address beat
interfaces.signals: u_ar_skid -> u_rd_req: w_ar_valid, w_ar_payload; u_rd_req -> u_ar_skid: w_ar_ready

interfaces.name: Write address beat
interfaces.signals: u_aw_skid -> u_wr_req: w_aw_valid, w_aw_payload; u_wr_req -> u_aw_skid: w_aw_ready

interfaces.name: Write data beat
interfaces.signals: u_w_skid -> u_wr_req: w_w_valid, w_w_payload; u_wr_req -> u_w_skid: w_w_ready

interfaces.name: Read request
interfaces.signals: u_rd_req -> u_arb: w_rd_req_valid, w_rd_req_payload; u_arb -> u_rd_req: w_rd_req_gnt

interfaces.name: Write request
interfaces.signals: u_wr_req -> u_arb: w_wr_req_valid, w_wr_req_payload; u_arb -> u_wr_req: w_wr_req_gnt

interfaces.name: Read slot allocation
interfaces.signals: u_arb -> u_rd_rob: w_rd_aloc, w_rd_aloc_meta; u_rd_rob -> u_arb: w_rd_slot, w_rd_slot_free

interfaces.name: Write slot allocation
interfaces.signals: u_arb -> u_wr_rob: w_wr_aloc, w_wr_aloc_meta; u_wr_rob -> u_arb: w_wr_slot, w_wr_slot_free

interfaces.name: Read completion
interfaces.signals: u_rsp_dec -> u_rd_rob: w_rd_done, w_rd_done_slot, w_rd_done_data, w_rd_done_err

interfaces.name: Write completion
interfaces.signals: u_rsp_dec -> u_wr_rob: w_wr_done, w_wr_done_slot, w_wr_done_err

interfaces.name: Status conditions
interfaces.signals: u_rsp_dec -> u_evt: w_evt_orphan, w_evt_bad; u_rd_req -> u_evt: w_evt_axi_err_rd; u_wr_req -> u_evt: w_evt_axi_err_wr

interfaces.name: Storage ports
interfaces.signals: u_rd_rob -> u_rd_store: w_store_wr_en, w_store_wr_addr, w_store_wr_data, w_store_rd_addr; u_rd_store -> u_rd_rob: w_store_rd_data

legend_note: The enclosing frame is the top module; blocks inside are its instances.
